params.prompt: Use the supplied Pelag identity image exactly: same current warm-skinned face, brown hair and pink headband, compact athletic human proportions, white short tunic and trousers, coral-pink sash, turquoise trim and brown sandals. Preserve current costume, face and body; this is an ability-effect concept, not a character redesign. Match our stylized dimensional painted game rendering with tactile materials. Fixed elevated three-quarter gameplay camera, plain readable forest-earth floor, full hero and full effect in frame, clean silhouette. No cinematic camera tilt, no photorealism, no anime redesign, no interface, no text, no invented extra weapons, no full-screen flash. Every effect has depth, thickness, directional motion and a sharp readable contact; never flat concentric graphic circles. Create a clean two-panel comparison on the same scale and camera. LEFT: the accepted base Whirlwind from the gameplay reference, the actual saber held firmly by its leather grip, its existing warm ivory-gold dimensional spiral around Pelag. Keep the base effect itself unchanged; keep the forest floor clear of distracting scenery. RIGHT: the SAME moment and base effect, plus the proposed visible outer cutting wave. A single thin but dimensional blade-like annular crest expands only OUTSIDE the base 2.3m circle toward 4m; a clear empty separation distinguishes it from the core sweep. The traveling crest carries bright ivory steel at its leading edge, warm gold reflected underside, a restrained dark edge matching the accepted ground ring, and a few directional wisps. Floor remains visible. The inner zone is not filled or hit by this outer wave; do not draw a solid disk, magic sigils, a bubble, fire, or several decorative rings. This is one outer wave emitted by one actual damaging rotation. The picture should make the additional reach instantly obvious without making the base effect larger. Do not attempt to demonstrate anchor mounting; frame the hero from front-side and keep stowed equipment unobtrusive.

Use the supplied Pelag identity image exactly: same current warm-skinned face, brown hair and pink headband, compact athletic human proportions, white short tunic and trousers, coral-pink sash, turquoise trim and brown sandals. Preserve current costume, face and body; this is an ability-effect concept, not a character redesign. Match our stylized dimensional painted game rendering with tactile materials. Fixed elevated three-quarter gameplay camera, plain readable forest-earth floor, full hero and full effect in frame, clean silhouette. No cinematic camera tilt, no photorealism, no anime redesign, no interface, no text, no invented extra weapons, no full-screen flash. Every effect has depth, thickness, directional motion and a sharp readable contact; never flat concentric graphic circles. Create a three-panel action beat board, same fixed game camera and scale: compact loaded preparation, the single heavy third-hit contact, then recovery. This illustrates the optional new Crushing Finale talent replacing a fourth input with a stronger THIRD finisher; do not add a fourth attack. Use the exact supplied anchor reference with its broad smooth curved flukes, solid dark metal mass, central diamond keel, top ring, linked chain and separate leather-wrapped hand grip. Pelag holds the GRIP firmly; connected chain leads to the actual top ring, visibly taut under load. Large believable weapon, never a toy, never a floating anchor. The finisher is a low heavy forward half-circle sweep, approximately 180 degrees and 2.8m reach, with planted leading foot, hip/shoulder rotation, counterbalancing torso and hands. At contact the heavy outer anchor head drives a short angular silver-white edge flash and dense local earth burst: a few substantial chips, low dust curled by its path, a brief compact impact star. The trail is a short dimensional ribbon following the real anchor path and fading behind it. Dust and debris remain in the forward semicircle; nothing erupts behind the hero. Show anchor mass through pose and localized response, not a huge glowing spell disk, long ground shockwave, pillar or whole-arena explosion. Face, body and actual weapon remain readable. Final panel shows decelerating weight and chain beginning to slacken, not a frozen impact pose. A still beat board is a visual proposal, not proof of animation or physics.
